context_requirements: Expression of butyrylcholinesterase (BCHE) in the assayed cell line
A measurable cholinergic or non-cholinergic signaling output coupled to BCHE activity
Presence of the drug at a concentration sufficient to inhibit BCHE at 10 micromolar
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
A shared transcriptional signature across multiple cell lines that is absent in vehicle controls
Evidence that the drug engages a transcriptional pathway independent of BCHE inhibition
